featureViz.objective: mean of the channel over all positions (Lucid "channel")
featureViz.parametrization: Fourier coefficients scaled by 1/max(|f|, 1/224), inverse FFT ÷ 4, decorrelated colour (√ of ImageNet colour SVD), sigmoid
featureViz.transforms: pad 12 px grey; jitter ≤ 8 px; scale 0.90–1.10; rotate −10°…10° (0 a quarter of the time); jitter ≤ 4 px; fresh each step
featureViz.raw: raw pixels through a sigmoid, starting from N(0, 1²) noise, no transforms
